svg.title: COSMILE multi-product Storefront reuse candidate
svg.desc: One design board containing an exact 390 by 844 mobile Home frame and an exact 1440 by 900 desktop responsive frame. Both reuse the existing warm cream and orange COSMILE shell, show data-bound admitted-product cards with detail, favorite, and cart actions, and map loading, omission, empty, failure, Google login, Toss TEST checkout, Golden Order, reversal, and history states without product identifiers or fabricated products.
svg.text: DATA-BOUND COPY · NO PRODUCT IDENTIFIERS · NO FABRICATED CARD
